newsitem.title: USA: UtiliCorp United unit inks natural gas pact.
newsitem.headline: UtiliCorp United unit inks natural gas pact.

text.p: Aquila Energy Corp, a subsidiary of UtiliCorp United Inc, said Thursday it signed a contract to provide natual gas to an affiliate of Calpine Corp worth an estimated $600 million.
Aquila Energy said it will supply up to 45 million cubic feet of natural gas per day to a 240-megawatt cogeneration project in Pasadena, Texas.

About 90 megawatts of electric power and 200,000 pounds per hour of steam will be sold to Phillips Petroleum Co once the project goes on line in 1998, Aquila Energy said. The remaining power will be sold in the wholesale market.
UtiliCorp United is an international electric and gas company. Its shares were unchanged Thursday afternoon at 27-3/8.
